customManagers.description: Bump tool versions pinned as workflow input defaults, marked with a 'renovate:' comment on the line above.

packageRules.description: Action and pinned tool bumps land as 'build' so they appear under the Dependencies changelog section; release-please treats 'build' as releasable (hidden: false in release-please-config.json) and cuts a patch release, updating the v0 tag that downstream repos consume.
Internal self-references use the moving v0 major tag on purpose - don't pin or bump them.
